title: 任务与指令系统缺乏优先级和队列管理
description: 任务队列和NPC指令系统缺乏优先级设置和排队功能，导致操作混乱和效率低下。
evidence: The job queing system lacks custom priority settings and causes all kinds of nonsense to happen
you can't even queue orders except in a very specific way that has no priority or order
Orders have no proper queue or priorities.
